inventory_basis.scope: Only the 26 pinned vendor boot/tool inputs.

positive_evidence: README.md lists Allwinner A733 / Orange Pi 4Pro as supported. sun60iw2.conf wires pack-uboot tools and selects board-family boot artifacts. These are provenance/build-use facts, not redistribution grants.
The vendor-tree root LICENSE is GPL-2.0 text. No inspected text expressly maps the opaque boot blobs or proprietary pack tools to it.
missing_or_open: No component-specific permission/source-offer record located for pinned boot0/monitor/SCP artifacts or pack-uboot tools.
No explicit licensing or source provenance record found for the pinned sys_config.fex or boot_package.cfg; their source/derivation remains unestablished here.

The pinned u-boot-current.dts is a text input, but this inventory found no nearby per-file license attribution. U-Boot upstream source is separately pinned; applicability to this file requires review.
No legal conclusion is made. Public binary redistribution remains an open release gate pending component/family evidence.
